newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat down at midesssion on pre-hedging.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat down at midesssion on pre-hedging.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures were lower at midsession, weakened mainly by commercial selling, floor sources said.
They said the selling was probably pre-hedging with harvesting beginning to gather pace in North Dakota.
"Harvest is the big issue. People are selling futures in expectation of buying cash," one dealer said.

The North Dakota Agricultural Statistics Service earlier this week reported the state's hard red spring wheat harvest was five percent complete, as of Sunday, in line with both last year's pace and the five-year average.
Early sellers included Benson Quinn (300 to 400 lots September), Prudential Securities (600 lots September) and LFG (300 lots December), floor sources said.
At 1050 CDT September was off 3-3/4 cents a bushel at $3.87-1/2. Other months were down 2-3/4 to 1-1/4 cents.
